gotchas: Start at https://www.cathaypacific.com/cx/en_US.html. A 'Cookies settings' modal blocks the page; 'Reject all' dismisses it. An 'Elevate your experience as a Cathay member' popover stays over the right half of the booking panel and over its dropdowns.

Booking panel: set the 'Trip type' combobox to 'One way'. The origin input[placeholder="Select a departure city"] is covered by div.bookTripPanel__odInputFieldSmall, so click that div first, clear the prefilled geo-located city, type a city name and click the first visible [role="option"]. Destination: type into input[placeholder="Select a destination"] and pick the option whose name contains the IATA code, e.g. '(TPE)'.

Dates: the 'Calendar Start Date' button opens the picker; day cells carry aria-label like 'October 23'; then Done. Search with #flight-booking-search-btn; its click can time out waiting for navigation though the search did start, so do not treat that as a failure.

Results (HKG-TPE, Light fare HKD 1,704 one way): click 'from HKD ... Lowest fare', then 'Select' on the fare family, then 'Continue with Light' in the 'Upgrade to Essential' drawer. The booking engine carries a reCAPTCHA (invisible badge).

Passenger page (Trip Summary): a 'Sign in' dialog offers 'Continue as guest'. 'Add passenger information' opens a drawer: Title is input[data-path="name.title"] (role=combobox, type=button), names are input[data-path="name.firstName"] / input[data-path="name.lastName"], then 'Save and continue'. Then Contact Information, travel insurance radios, and 'Select seat and extras' or 'Review and pay'.
